single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.scope: Experimental single-host diagnostic; no equilibrium or coexistence certification

vacancy_relocation.timing: after GCMC/local translations, before fixed-clock observation and label updates
vacancy_relocation.interpretation: Proposal diagnostics only; counters do not certify equilibrium, phase coverage, or regeneration

calibration_weight_replay.scope: Constant-gain increments replay from prior POST to current PRE when projection is enabled, otherwise between checkpoints. Actual count differences and a conservative path bound exclude every intervening clamp; enabled corrections separately pass independent KKT checks. This is bookkeeping, not equilibrium evidence.

single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.calibration_label_quota_scope: Sampling allocations over extended-ensemble labels during discarded adaptation, not phase probabilities. Frozen conditional physical targets and reward/dwell estimators are unchanged.

normalizer_projection.scope: Discarded calibration label-normalizer efficiency regularization only; not assumed work or phase probabilities
Discarded calibration label-normalizer efficiency regularization only; not assumed work or phase probabilities

discarded_calibration_outcome.scope: Discarded label-efficiency diagnostics only; neither flatness nor stability certifies physical phase equilibration

single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.calibration_scope: All adaptation observations are discarded. Recorded flatness/stability outcomes check label-efficiency bookkeeping only and do not certify equilibrium or physical phase mixing.
single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.label_transition_scope: Clock rows precede label updates. Compound Gibbs/neighbor clocks require the separately recorded post-Gibbs neighbor-source labels; next-row differences are not neighbor acceptance counts. Cycle rewards retain every recorded pre-hop dwell.
single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.phase_label_scope: The reported solid label is the operational Fourier criterion B>0.45, not an independently established thermodynamic phase; low-N and alternative structural order require separate coordinate checks.

whole_cycle_bootstrap_covariance.scope: Common whole-cycle resamples; no undefined draw is discarded. Any pair with an undefined draw has undefined covariance.

single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.partition_ratio_convention: Z_cavity/Z_base=(D_cavity/D_base)*exp(g_base-g_cavity); beta W=-log(Z_cavity/Z_base). D is summed full-clock dwell over complete cycles, not an acceptance or transition count.
single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.uncertainty_scope: Complete-cycle reward/dwell ratios with common whole-cycle resampling. The underlying refreshed cycles are independent at frozen weights, but a fixed-clock stop selects a random duration-dependent prefix. Standard errors are asymptotic and conditional on observed cycle coverage, not exact finite-sample unbiased inference, an effective physical-snapshot count, or proof of equilibration

coverage.cycle_interval_convention: refresh event row inclusive to next refresh event row exclusive; initial and unfinished terminal partial cycles omitted

single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.physical_node_profile_scope: Each activity/radius is a separate conditional target; no activity pooling. Ratios use only complete-cycle clock rewards with zero-dwell cycles retained. B>0.45 is an operational Fourier indicator, not a thermodynamic solid classifier at low N. The separate dense indicator additionally requires N>=20 and has no reused delete-one/Palm diagnostic. Residual CLT errors are asymptotic and subject to the global incomplete-cycle/coverage warnings.
single_walker_nested_projection_protocol.quarter_scope: Descriptive full-clock quarters, including leading/trailing partial cycles; distinct from the complete-cycle estimator and not independent replicates
